configuration.title: GROWI
configuration.growi.baseUrl.markdownDesc: Base URL for the target GROWI instance.
configuration.growi.pageListing.initialP: Number of pages to fetch for the first page listing request.
configuration.growi.pageListing.maxAutoP: Maximum number of pages to fetch per registered prefix when Open Page searches after user input.
configuration.growi.localMirror.maxPrefi: Maximum number of pages allowed in a prefix local mirror export. Values above 200 are clamped to 200.
